title: tidy_scan
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.13) — shape from tidy-prd.md §7 tidy_scan, FR-1, FR-2, FR-9; not routed yet. Upstream: adobe/tools/tidy/_upstream/jsx/host.jsx:111 TIDY.scan (entry tidy_scan :308). CEP WNC_TIDY.scan (signed bridge). Contract keys are snake_case; the port translates the upstream camelCase keys (docs/adobe/phase-6b-reservations.md). Read only: walk the project tree (items and bins), usage per sequence (project items referenced by the clips of its video + audio tracks) and up to 3 graphic Source Texts per sequence.

data.description: No data (the upstream function reads no argument).

bin.description: parent bin path, '' at the project root

path.description: media path, '' for a sequence or when unknown

offline.description: Premiere's isOffline (FR-3: unreliable, the engine checks the file)

items.description: {node_id,name,bin,is_sequence,path,offline,color,duration}. The object stays open: keys the host adds are not rejected.
{node_id,path,name}. The object stays open: keys the host adds are not rejected.

usage.description: {sequence item nodeId (sequenceID when it has none): [nodeIds]}

additionalProperties.description: raw JSON pieces from '"textEditValue"', at most 4000 chars

texts.description: {sequence nodeId: [raw Source Text]} (FR-2, top video track first, at most 3); sequences without graphic text are absent

readback.description: {items,bins,usage,texts,project,name}. The object stays open: keys the host adds are not rejected.
